wikipedia.title: Dresden Generating Station
wikipedia.extract: Dresden Generating Station (also known as Dresden Nuclear Power Plant or Dresden Nuclear Power Station) is the first privately financed nuclear power plant built in the United States. Dresden 1 was activated in 1960 and retired in 1978. Operating since 1970 are Dresden units 2 and 3, two General Electric BWR-3 boiling water reactors.  Dresden Station is located on a 953-acre (386 ha) site in Grundy County, Illinois near the city of Morris.  It is at the head of the Illinois River, where the Des Plaines River and Kankakee River meet.
